spotlight.title: Mary Grossman's confirm-by window closes tonight at 6:45 PM PT — and there is still no sign she has been reached
spotlight.detail: Mary Grossman (NV, lead L-MTQ3VBRQ-BC, +1 805 302 2655, grossmanmary885@gmail.com) asked for a callback around today when she came in off the $300 Plan on Sep 6. Two calendar invites stand: “confirm her time before 6:45 PM PT” (9:30 PM IST tonight) and “CALL MARY GROSSMAN — real lead, call by hand” (7:15 AM IST tomorrow). As of this brief the sweep shows no contact, no referral and no written decision — she is the only real prospect on the desk and has been reachable for five days. The first move is the compliance call, not the dial: 0/7 and NV is outside licensed area, so decide call / refer / hold in writing before the window shuts tonight.

spotlight.title: The autonomous stack is going dark exactly as the AM brief warned — the AI lanes have gone silent while the credit org sits at zero
spotlight.detail: The AM brief flagged the Claude API org “Oraya” out of credits at 15:55Z Sep 10. The consequence is now visible: no FA-ADS watchdog check-in and no daily digest have fired since Sep 10 (last watchdog 17:06Z, last digest 15:00Z) — the lanes that need the AI are quiet. The one automation still sending is the plain Meta→CRM sync, which needs no model — and it has failed on the hour every hour since the AM brief: 14 consecutive “ORAYA SYNC FAILED” emails from 00:32Z to 13:32Z, each pulling Meta cleanly then hitting a 403 “CONNECT tunnel failed / organization policy” on the POST to the CRM. Two fixes, one each: add API credits (Billing), and allowlist aura-frankie-insurance.vercel.app for the scheduled task's egress.

spotlight.title: Fifteen days of paid consumer dialing against a gate still at 0/7 — now with a live prospect waiting on it
spotlight.detail: b3 (TX telephone-solicitor registration) and b7 (CA producer license #) remain the two numbers that block everything downstream. Day 15 of paid traffic, and today the gate is not abstract: Mary Grossman is a real NV consumer whose call window closes tonight and who legally cannot be dialed until the gate clears or a scoped rule is written. Unblock: the NPN + CA license # + TX filing status, or a one-line written rule for who may be dialed in the meantime.
